en-US.offline_payments_need_connection: Payments and money figures need a connection. They are not kept on this device.
en-US.offline_document_not_saved: This document is not saved on this device. Connect to the internet to open it.
en-US.offline_documents_need_connection: This needs a connection. Without one, documents can be read but not created, changed, sent or signed.
en-US.offline_document_step_needs_connection: This needs a connection. Without one you can make a document from a template saved on this device and edit drafts. Sending, signing, PDFs, invoices, change orders and steps that act on the server wait until you reconnect.
en-US.offline_document_made_note: This document was made without a connection. Lines, totals and account figures appear when you reconnect.
en-US.offline_document_view_note: You are seeing this document as it was last calculated, with your changes. Figures with a dotted underline update when you reconnect.
en-US.offline_document_value_pending: Saved on this device. The document recalculates when you reconnect.
en-US.offline_change_needs_connection: This needs a connection. Nothing was saved.
en-US.offline_not_on_device: This is not saved on this device. Connect to the internet to see it.
en-US.offline_messages_send_later: You're offline. Messages will send when you reconnect.
en-US.offline_message_needs_connection: Not sent. Replies and attachments need a connection.
en-US.offline_send_needs_connection: Sending needs a connection. Your message is still here; send it when you are back online.
en-US.offline_older_messages_not_on_device: Older messages are not saved on this device.
en-US.offline_project_messages_not_on_device: This project's messages are not saved on this device. Connect to the internet to see them.
